# gitea_labels (Data Source)

Use this data source to list labels in an organization or repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_labels" "example" {
  user = "my-org"
  repo = "my-repo"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org` (String) Organization name
- `repo` (String) Repository name
- `user` (String) User or organization owner of the repository

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `labels` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--labels))

<a id="nestedatt--labels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `labels`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `exclusive` (Boolean)
- `id` (Number)
- `name` (String)
